text_en: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense that I now make before you. ”
text_cn: “诸位仁人弟兄，诸位父老！请听我现在对你们的分辩。”

text_en: When they heard him addressing them in Hebrew, they became even more quiet. Then he said:
text_cn: 他们听见保禄用希伯来话向他们致辞，就更为安静了。保禄说：

text_en: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, educated strictly according to our ancestral law, being zealous for God, just as all of you are today.
text_cn: “我原是犹太人，生于基里基雅的塔尔索，却在这城里长大，在加玛里耳足前，对祖传的法律，曾受过精确的教育；对天主我也是热忱的，就如你们大家今天一样。

text_en: I persecuted this Way up to the point of death by binding both men and women and putting them in prison,
text_cn: 我曾迫害过这道，直到死地；不论男女，逮捕捆绑送入狱中；

text_en: as the high priest and the whole council of elders can testify about me. From them I also received letters to the brothers in Damascus, and I went there in order to bind those who were there and to bring them back to Jerusalem for punishment.
text_cn: 就是大司祭和整个长老团，都可给我作证；我从他们那里领了给弟兄们的文书，往大马士革去，有意把那里的这样的人加以逮捕，带到耶路撒冷来处罚。

text_en: “While I was on my way and approaching Damascus, about noon a great light from heaven suddenly shone about me.
text_cn: 当我前行临近大马士革时，约在中午，忽然天上有一道大光，环射到我身上，

text_en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? ’
text_cn: 我便跌在地上，听见有声音向我说：扫禄，扫禄！你为什么迫害我？

text_en: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord? ’ Then he said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth whom you are persecuting. ’
text_cn: 我回答说：主，你是谁？他向我说：我就是你所迫害的那个纳匝肋人耶稣。

text_en: Now those who were with me saw the light but did not hear the voice of the one who was speaking to me.
text_cn: 同我在一起的人，只看见那光，却听不见那对我说话的声音。

text_en: I asked, ‘What am I to do, Lord? ’ The Lord said to me, ‘Get up and go to Damascus; there you will be told everything that has been assigned to you to do. ’
text_cn: 我说：主，我当作什么？主向我说：你起来，往大马士革去，在那里有人要告诉你，给你派定当作的一切事。

text_en: Since I could not see because of the brightness of that light, those who were with me took my hand and led me to Damascus.
text_cn: 由于那光的炫耀，我看不见了，就由我的同伴用手领着，进了大马士革。

text_en: “A certain Ananias, who was a devout man according to the law and well spoken of by all the Jews living there,
text_cn: 有个人名叫阿纳尼雅，是虔诚守法的人，所有住在那里的犹太人都称誉他。

text_en: came to me; and standing beside me, he said, ‘Brother Saul, regain your sight! ’ In that very hour I regained my sight and saw him.
text_cn: 他来见我，站在旁边向我说：扫禄兄弟，你看见罢！我当时向他一望，就看见了他。

text_en: Then he said, ‘The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will, to see the Righteous One and to hear his own voice;
text_cn: 他说：我们祖先的天主，预简了你，叫你认识他的意愿，看见那位义者，并由他口中听到声音，

text_en: for you will be his witness to all the world of what you have seen and heard.
text_cn: 因为你要向众人，对你所见所闻的事，为他作证人。

text_en: And now why do you delay? Get up, be baptized, and have your sins washed away, calling on his name. ’
text_cn: 现在你还迟延什么？起来领洗，呼求他的名，洗除你的罪恶罢！

text_en: “After I had returned to Jerusalem and while I was praying in the temple, I fell into a trance
text_cn: 我回到耶路撒冷，在殿里祈祷时，就神魂超拔，

text_en: and saw Jesus saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not accept your testimony about me. ’
text_cn: 看见主向我说：赶紧，快快离开耶路撒冷，因为这里的人，将不接受你为我作的证。

text_en: And I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that in every synagogue I imprisoned and beat those who believed in you.
text_cn: 我就说：主！这是因为他们知道：我经常把信你的人下在监里，并在各会堂里鞭打他们；

text_en: And while the blood of your witness Stephen was shed, I myself was standing by, approving and keeping the coats of those who killed him. ’
text_cn: 当你的证人斯德望的血倾流时，我本人还站在旁边予以赞同，并且看守杀他的人们的衣服！

text_en: Then he said to me, ‘Go, for I will send you far away to the Gentiles. ’”
text_cn: 他向我说：你去！因为我要打发你到远方外邦人那里去。”

text_en: Up to this point they listened to him, but then they shouted, “Away with such a fellow from the earth! For he should not be allowed to live. ”
text_cn: 他们听他说到这句话，便扬声说：“从地上除掉这样的人，他不该活着！”

text_en: And while they were shouting, throwing off their cloaks, and tossing dust into the air,
text_cn: 他们遂喧哗呐喊，扔下衣服，并向空中扬土。

text_en: the tribune directed that he was to be brought into the barracks, and ordered him to be examined by flogging, to find out the reason for this outcry against him.
text_cn: 千夫长只得下令将保禄带进营里，说是要用鞭子拷问他，以便知道他们为什么缘故这样喊叫反对他。

text_en: But when they had tied him up with thongs, Paul said to the centurion who was standing by, “Is it legal for you to flog a Roman citizen who is uncondemned? ”
text_cn: 当士兵用皮条将保禄绑好时，保禄向旁边站着的百夫长说：“一个罗马人，又没有被定罪，难道你们就可以鞭打他么？”

text_en: When the centurion heard that, he went to the tribune and said to him, “What are you about to do? This man is a Roman citizen. ”
text_cn: 百夫长听了，就来到千夫长前报告说：“你可怎么办？这个人是罗马人！”

text_en: The tribune came and asked Paul, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen? ” And he said, “Yes. ”
text_cn: 千夫长就前来问保禄说：“告诉我，你是罗马人吗？”保禄说：“是。”

text_en: The tribune answered, “It cost me a large sum of money to get my citizenship. ” Paul said, “But I was born a citizen. ”
text_cn: 千夫长回答说：“我用一大笔钱才购得这个公民权。”保禄说：“我却生来就是。”

text_en: Immediately those who were about to examine him drew back from him; and the tribune also was afraid, for he realized that Paul was a Roman citizen and that he had bound him.
text_cn: 于是那些要拷问保禄的人，便立即离开他走了。千夫长一知道他是罗马人，又因为曾捆绑了他，就害怕起来。

text_en: Since he wanted to find out what Paul was being accused of by the Jews, the next day he released him and ordered the chief priests and the entire council to meet. He brought Paul down and had him stand before them.
text_cn: 第二天，千夫长愿意知道，保禄为什么被犹太人控告的实情，就解开他，并命令司祭长及全体公议会集合；随后将保禄带下来，叫他站在他们面前。
